    So if you need testing or just want some fun on a car or motorcycle track day, Pembrey Circuit is the place to be.

WHAT TO EXPECT

The Motorsport UK British Rallycross Championship 5 Nations Trophy descends on South Wales for what promises to be an action-packed two days of blockbuster wheel-to-wheel entertainment.

Making its annual trip to Pembrey for a crucial double-header, tarmac and dirt fuse together to create an adrenaline rush like no other - with sideways thrill and spill all-but guaranteed.

On top of the headline act, the weekend will also see a bumper bill of support race action also play out around the challenging twists and turns of Pembrey’s rallycross circuit.

Aside from the racing, visitors will be able to get up close to all of the machines out on-track courtesy of the open paddock whilst food and drink will be available to purchase from the Pembrey cafe.

EVENT FAQS

TICKETS

Tickets for the majority of events can be purchased online in advance. Tickets are also available to purchase on the day of the event at the gate.

Yes, tickets are available to purchase on the day.

All tickets are sent by email to the email address used to purchase the e-tickets. Please keep an eye on your junk/spam folders. If you have ordered your e-tickets and can't find them, please call the ticket office on 01554 891042 and we will try to help you.

For the fastest access into the venue, we recommend that you print your tickets.

You can also show tickets on your mobile phone, however, to avoid delays we recommend downloading and saving these to your device.

Unfortunately not. Tickets are available to purchase in advance for the majority of events - for the quickest way into the venue. Alternatively, tickets can be purchased at the gate on arrival.

EVENT INFORMATION

Pre-booking is required for certain race meetings including the British Truck Racing Championship (Convoy Cymru). 'View ticket choices' on each event to find out more about camping for each race meeting or email us at pembrey@barc.net if you'd like further clarification.

Entry after 18:00 on the Friday.

Children aged 12 and under are admitted free of charge to the Circuit. Please be aware that a valid ticket is still required for children.

Parking is free of charge when purchasing a entry ticket to the meeting.

This varies depending on the event. Please refer to your e-ticket for more information about when the gates open.

Typically, the last race/event will finished at approximately 17:00. Please be aware that this may vary depending on the event.

We have a designated banking area for Blue Badge holders, which is accessible via the main entrance. This is a raised bank for you to park your car, providing a view over a section of the circuit. There is also disabled parking inside the main entrance. Ask a member of the security staff to direct you if you're unsure. All passengers/driver must have relevant admission tickets.

Yes, the Formula One bar/restaurant or the race administration office in the paddock

In the event that a child is found to be lost within the circuit, they will be taken to the race administration office where staff will care for them until they are reunited with their parent/guardian.

If you need medical assistance, contact a member of staff who will take the appropriate action.

Motorsport events can be dangerous and the health and safety of our attendees and participants is of primary importance. Allowing any animals onto the event site can increase the health and safety risks and danger inherent in these types of events.

There are baby changing facilities in the outside block in the paddock.

Yes. Visitors are welcome to bring gazebos, pop-up shelters and windbreakers for use on the spectator banks. We simply ask that you position them considerately and securly so they do not obstruct the view of other spectators, particularly during busy periods. Event staff may ask you to relocate if a structure is causing an obstruction or creating a safety concern.

Camping at Pembrey

Yes. Caravans and campervans are welcome in the campsite areas at Pembrey. Camping tickets must be purchased in advance, All campers must have seperate admission tickets. All vehicles should be parked in the designated camping areas as directed by event staff on arrival.
